# md2slides

> Markdown slide decks synced to GitHub. One .md file = one deck.

## Docs

- [Full syntax, single file](/llms-full.txt): everything below in one document — give this to your LLM.
- [File structure](/llms-full.txt#file-structure): front-matter, --- separators, kicker, title, notes, columns
- [Slide directives](/llms-full.txt#slide-directives): per-slide bg, color, pad, align, titleSize, zoom, clicks, src
- [Blocks](/llms-full.txt#blocks): lists, cards, stats, flow, timeline, code, terminal, table, callout, quote, image, math, csv, counter, anim (typewriter, shimmer, stagger, gradient, float, pulse)
- [Charts](/llms-full.txt#chart): column, bar, line, donut, pie, rings

- [Gallery](/llms-full.txt#gallery): grid, strip, circles, mosaic
- [Diagrams](/llms-full.txt#more-diagrams): pipeline, steps, stack, hub, cycle, funnel, pyramid, Mermaid (all diagram types)
- [Media layouts](/llms-full.txt#media-layouts): image-left, image-right, image-full, image-top, diagonal, circle, arch
- [Presenting](/llms-full.txt#presenting): click reveals, zoom, imports, logo
- [Motion](/llms-full.txt#motion): 21 transitions, 8 block animations, stagger
- [Writing rules](/llms-full.txt#writing-rules-for-good-decks): how to write decks that look good

## Features

- Themes: 4 palettes × dark/light slides, 6 backgrounds, 5 font pairings, glass on/off
- Editor: color-coded Markdown, / insert menu with previews, ⌘K palette, problems panel, format
- Blocks: click any block to restyle it or transform it into another block type
- Git: nested repo browser, per-file dirty state, commit dialog with line diff
- Present: presenter view, notes, timer + limit, pen, laser, blackout, zoom, click reveals, share links
- AI: generate decks from a prompt using llms-full.txt as context
